description: This file defines the internal class GrainVersionManifest, which manages querying and caching version information for grain interfaces and types within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for retrieving local versions, available versions, and supported silos for specific grain interfaces and types, utilizing thread-safe collections and cache invalidation strategies.

classes.name: GrainVersionManifest
classes.description: Manages version information for grain interfaces and types, providing methods to query local versions, available versions, and supported silos, with internal caching and thread safety.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Internal cache structure holding version and silo support data to optimize repeated queries.

methods.name: GetLocalVersion
methods.description: Returns the local version of a specified grain interface type, resolving generic interfaces if necessary.

methods.name: GetAvailableVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all known versions for a given grain interface type, considering generic mappings.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the set of silos supporting a specific grain interface type and version, resolving generics if needed.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the silos supporting a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns silos supporting a specific grain type, interface type, and versions array.

methods.name: BuildLocalVersionMap
methods.description: Builds a map of grain interface types to their local versions from a grain manifest.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a cache of version and silo support data from the cluster manifest.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if the cluster manifest version has changed.
